name: pcap_extract
description: Export protocol objects from a capture with tshark, keep every object on disk, and write a complete path/size/SHA-256 provenance index. This is the command-line equivalent of NetworkMiner-style object extraction.

out_dir.description: An empty directory under work/ for exported objects and index.tsv

protocols.description: Wireshark export protocols (default: http, smb, smb2, tftp, imf)

display_filter.description: Optional Wireshark display filter limiting what is exported
